title: Posture profile and trusted network wire details the SDK models drop

prose.text: Posture profiles and trusted networks are read-only, v2 for lists and v1 for a single object, with the object fields in [[zpa.posture-profiles.object-model]] and [[zpa.trusted-networks.object]]. The Go lookups by posture UDID and by network id read the whole list and compare client-side, see [[zpa.posture-profiles.api-surface]] and [[zpa.trusted-networks.object]]; the 500-per-page size they use is in [[zpa.api.pagination]].

prose.label: What the Python model hides.
prose.text: {{python-posture-model-omits-domain}} The Python model's tab in the rootCert key and its boolean defaults are in [[zpa.posture-profiles.object-model]].
The platform field is a list in the contract and a string in Go {{divergence:posture-platform-shape}}.

checks.do: Whether a posture profile's domain was read through the Python SDK, whose model does not carry it.

python-posture-model-omits-domain.statement: The API document and the Go PostureProfile type both carry a domain field, but the Python PostureProfile model has no domain attribute, so a posture profile read through Python does not expose it.

python-posture-model-omits-domain.conditions: Absence is read from the whole model file at the pin: the string domain does not occur in it. The Python trusted network model does carry domain.

posture-platform-shape.summary: The OpenAPI document and the Python SDK give a posture profile's `platform` as a list of strings, while the Go SDK declares it as a single string.

positions.says: The contract response has platform as an array of strings.
The Python model reads platform as a list of strings.

quotes: self.platform = ZscalerCollection.form_list(config["platform"] if "platform" in config else [], str)
evidence.after: self.zscaler_customer_id = config["zscalerCustomerId"] if config and "zscalerCustomerId" in config else None

positions.says: The Go PostureProfile declares Platform as one string.

quotes: Platform string `json:"platform,omitempty"`

posture-platform-shape.impact: A Go caller decoding a response whose platform is a list gets a decode error or an empty value instead of the platforms; the live response is not captured.
